verdict.rationale: Telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS point-of-sale app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The 'track' mentions refer to orders and inventory, not user telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
